# NEW 2026-11-22 v15.5 Module 15.5-B: Qing 2.0 Deep Overhaul (oe_qg2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v155_ming_qing.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_three_feudatories = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique

	can_start = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_started }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_ended }
		current_year >= 1668
		current_year <= 1740
		country_exists = c:MCH
		c:MCH = { oe_qg2_three_feudatories_eligible = yes }
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_qg2_is_host = yes
			oe_mg2_is_host = yes
			tag = KOR
			tag = DAI
			tag = TIB
			tag = OIR
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:south_china_region
					region = region:east_china_region
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:west_china_region
					region = region:manchuria_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Imperial Centralization Triumph (Three Feudatories Abolished)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_imperial"
		desc = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_imperial_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_qg2_tf_imperial_victory = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_ended value = 1 }
			oe_qg2_tf_resolve_imperial = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Southern Feudatories Entrenched
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_autonomy"
		desc = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_autonomy_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_qg2_tf_feudatory_autonomy = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_ended value = 2 }
			oe_qg2_tf_resolve_autonomy = yes
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Negotiated Southern Pacification
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_compromise"
		desc = "oe_sit_three_feudatories_compromise_desc"
		trigger = {
			oe_qg2_tf_negotiated_settlement = yes
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_ended value = 3 }
			oe_qg2_tf_resolve_settlement = yes
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_started value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_months value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_progress value = 25 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_tension value = 55 }
		oe_qg2_tf_on_start = yes
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_months }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_months add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_qg2_tf_months value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					current_month = 1
					current_month = 7
				}
			}
			oe_qg2_tf_biannual_sync = yes
		}
	}

	on_ended = { }

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:kunming
					this = location:minxian
					this = location:guangzhou
					this = location:panyu
					this = location:gaoyao
					this = location:lingui
					this = location:changsha
					this = location:hengyang
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_map_feudatory_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_qg2_is_host = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_map_imperial_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_mg2_is_host = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_map_loyalist_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = {
					OR = {
						tag = KOR
						tag = DAI
						tag = TIB
						tag = OIR
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_qg2_map_observer_tt
		}
	}

	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					this = location:kunming
					this = location:minxian
					this = location:guangzhou
					this = location:panyu
					this = location:gaoyao
					this = location:lingui
					this = location:changsha
					this = location:hengyang
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_qg2_is_host = yes }
			}
			value = owner.country_color
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { oe_mg2_is_host = yes }
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = KOR
						tag = DAI
						tag = TIB
						tag = OIR
					}
				}
			}
			value = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}
}
